تخاذلت (form VI)
# تَخَاذَلْتُ (taḵāḏaltu) /ta.xaː.ðal.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَخَاذَلَ (taḵāḏala)
# تَخَاذَلْتَ (taḵāḏalta) /ta.xaː.ðal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَخَاذَلَ (taḵāḏala)
# تَخَاذَلْتِ (taḵāḏalti) /ta.xaː.ðal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَخَاذَلَ (taḵāḏala)
# تَخَاذَلَتْ (taḵāḏalat) /ta.xaː.ða.lat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
